actual_scope: Scoped algebraic proof of the monomial tangent restriction and exact ordered covariant stabilizer determinant image for multiplication in F_q[x_1,...,x_d]/(x_i^n), d>=2, n not a power of the characteristic.
scope_change_reason: The assigned bit-new-register-model card is changed to an algebraic side result on the nilpotent-algebra question of PR5252. It does not meet the card physical mechanism or paid-profile acceptance gate.
bottleneck_link: Algebraic side result only. It gives complete symmetry character restrictions for a new multiplication-tensor class; no physical supplier, complete bill or kappa consequence is claimed.
stop_rule: Stop at the first proved non-Frobenius character formula and its bounded exact corroboration. Unequal cutoffs and recognition remain open.
evidence: Written all-finite-field proof; 138 attaining automorphisms in 15 contexts; 66,265 complete generator-image pairs with 2,120 accepted automorphisms; 310 unit maps; 232,714 basis-product checks; 3,243 determinant triples and 64 literal tensor coefficients; rejecting domain and convention controls.
